subject: Emotions
title: Burnout Is Emotional Exhaustion
description: A quick win: understand Burnout Is Emotional Exhaustion.

hook.text: She loved teaching for 15 years. Now she feels nothing—not burnt out from overwork but from emotional depletion.

buildup.text: Christina Maslach named three burnout components: emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and reduced accomplishment.

discovery.text: Emotional exhaustion is the core: when your capacity to feel for others runs dry, the job becomes unbearable.

twist.text: Burnout isn't about hours worked. Nurses working 12-hour shifts with good teams burn out less than 8-hour solo workers.

climax.text: Prevention requires emotional replenishment: genuine connection, autonomy, and feeling your work matters.

punchline.text: Burnout isn't running out of energy. It's running out of feeling.

quiz.question: What is the core component of burnout according to Maslach?
